# requires: wire
#
# A 206 that begins at zero when it was asked to begin at forty. The bytes are
# the artifact's own, so nothing about them is corrupt and nothing about the
# length is wrong -- written at the offset asked for, they put real content in
# the wrong place, which no transport error and no length check can see. Only
# Content-Range says so, and only if somebody reads it.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:offset
claim A alpha 5000
stage A 40
progress A alpha 40 {"verified_prefix":40}
release A alpha
run A beta
orphans
state A

# expect 6: ok state=transferred [DL-R7]
# expect 6: done=64 err=none
# expect 7: ok - [DL-R10]
